summary: The note describes the location of Przemków Landscape Park, which lies in Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland. It spans parts of Bolesławiec County and Polkowice County, covering several gminas (municipal units) in those two counties. The note is very brief and gives no further details on the park's history, ecology or features.
one_line: Przemków Landscape Park is a protected area in Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland, spanning parts of Bolesławiec and Polkowice counties.
key_facts: Przemków Landscape Park lies within Lower Silesian Voivodeship.
The park lies in Bolesławiec County, in Gmina Gromadka.
The park lies in Polkowice County, in Gmina Chocianów.
The park lies in Polkowice County, in Gmina Gaworzyce.
The park lies in Polkowice County, in Gmina Przemków.
The park lies in Polkowice County, in Gmina Radwanice.
